fullDescription: Primary membership management view for searching existing customer profiles before opening a new account. It renders the branded top bar, action tiles for new and pending memberships, a centered search form, and a results table with member details, status badges, and membership action links using the reusable membership registration shell.

Composable membership management component that assembles the branded application header, high-level membership action tiles, centered lookup form, and a reusable result table for member records. It supports searchable membership workflows with status badges, contact details, and action links while reusing shared input, button, badge, and table primitives inside a consistent branded shell.

Structured membership form component for attaching a secondary member to a primary account. It includes the branded header, step rail, personal identity fields, contact verification rows, address checkboxes, and bottom action groups, and is composed from shared button, input, select, and checkbox primitives so other membership views can reuse the same form sections or shell.

Compact verification dialog for confirming multiple member contacts in one flow. It supports verified and pending rows, avatar presentation, warning and success status states, grouped four-digit code inputs, resend actions, and a primary completion button so other membership flows can reuse the same confirmation pattern.

Profile-photo capture component that renders the branded application header, camera selection control, neutral preview stage, instructional compliance card, and bottom action bar for navigation, canceling, capturing, and confirming a saved image. It reuses the shared button and select primitives and can support additional photo-capture states in other member flows.

Full-page membership form component for opening a new member account. It includes the branded application header, a two-step progress rail, personal information inputs, contact verification rows, address fields, a secondary memberships section, and footer actions for saving or advancing to payment. It reuses the shared button, input, select, and checkbox primitives so future membership screens can share the same sections and shell.
